text: Can't install SpecDeck, for example on a company laptop? You can watch a session in your browser instead. Hosting still needs the app.
Open the web link the host shared, or go to the sharing service's address and type the invite code.
The code is never sent to the server: in a link, it sits after the hash, which browsers keep to themselves.
Enter your name, and select Watch in this browser. There is no account: your name stays in this browser.
You see the session as in the app: the files, the terminal and documents in tabs, and the timeline.
The layout menu has Overview, Developer and Present, and the appearance: System follows your browser, or choose Light or Dark.
If something goes wrong, Export diagnostics in the same menu saves a file for a bug report.
Some keys differ, because the browser keeps its own. Press the question mark to see them all.
Each page joins only sessions on its own sharing service, and comes from that service, so you trust whoever runs it.
